answer: None of the provided articles tell customers to use a retired form. The only retired form mentioned is NW-POA-1. 'When more than one person owns the car' says NW-POA-2 replaced it on February 1, 2026, and that an NW-POA-1 signed before then was accepted only until June 30, 2026, so it is no longer accepted today. That article points customers to NW-POA-2, and the other articles mention only current forms (NW-EST-1, NW-LPA-1, NW-MIL-1, NW-PU-1) or no forms at all.
